caption: The drawing depicts a carved male figure standing on a dark greenish-blue irregular base. The figure is nude except for a draped yellowish-gold garment over his head and shoulders, which extends down the back as a cloak colored with a reddish hue on the inside. His right hand is bent across his body, covering part of his chest, while his left hand is positioned near his waist. The figure has a full, dark beard and mustache, his facial expression is neutral, and the eyes are directed slightly upwards. The overall coloration of the body is a pale, flesh-like tone with shaded lines indicating wood grain and contours. The use of muted colors and visible lines creates a textured, three-dimensional appearance. The background is plain and uncolored.
title: Figurehead: Hercules
